description: Osaki/Titan warranty intake workflow. Delivery splits status lookup vs damage claim. The backend engine controls ALL branching. The LLM only paraphrases 'prompt' fields into customer-friendly language. The LLM must NEVER decide on replacement, compensation, tech dispatch, or refund — those are admin-only actions reached through 'awaiting_admin' terminals.

root.prompt: Welcome to Osaki & Titan support! Is this a Warranty issue or a Sales inquiry?

sales_routing.prompt: How can I help you today?
sales_routing.internal_note: Route to sales flow / sales agent. This is not a warranty case.

issue_type.prompt: Which area do you need help with: setup, delivery, or a chair malfunction?

delivery_intent_q.prompt: How can we help with your delivery today?

options.label: Report damage or a delivery problem

delivery_status_tracking_q.prompt: Do you have a tracking number for your delivery?

options.label: No, I don't have a tracking number
Yes, I have my tracking number

delivery_status_get_order_email.prompt: Please share your checkout email (preferred). If you also have an order number, include both — for example: #12345 you@example.com so we can look up your delivery status.

delivery_status_get_tracking.prompt: Please share your tracking number so we can look up your delivery status.

delivery_status_terminal.prompt: Thanks — we've received your details and looked up what we can on our side. Our team will follow up with your delivery status shortly.
delivery_status_terminal.internal_note: Status-only delivery inquiry. Use collected order/email/tracking + delivery_lookup snapshot. Check Netsuite/Shopify/carrier and reply to the customer.

install_model.prompt: What model is your massage chair? (e.g., OS-4000T, Titan Pro Commander)

install_concern.prompt: What installation issue are you having?

options.label: Footrest problem or no air anywhere on the chair

install_air_hose_terminal.prompt: Many footrest and whole-chair air issues are fixed by reconnecting the air hose between the footrest and the base. I'll walk you through the steps and share your model's installation video.
install_air_hose_terminal.internal_note: Post-install: footrest-to-base air hose often not connected during assembly. Customer-safe DIY first; team follow-up if still no air.

install_send_video.prompt: I will send you the installation guide and YouTube video link for your specific model right away.
install_send_video.internal_note: Look up the installation YouTube video for the stated model and send the link to the customer.

delivery_tracking_q.prompt: Do you have a tracking number for your delivery?

options.label: No, I don't have a tracking number
Yes, I have my tracking number

delivery_get_name.prompt: Please share your checkout email (preferred). If you also have an order number, include both — for example: #12345 you@example.com. Next we'll ask what kind of delivery problem you have.

delivery_get_tracking_number.prompt: Please share your tracking number so we can locate your shipment. Next we'll ask what kind of delivery problem you have.

delivery_problem_type_q.prompt: What best describes the delivery problem?

options.label: Never arrived / marked delivered but missing

delivery_missing_parts_q.prompt: What parts or items are missing from your delivery?

delivery_missing_parts_terminal.prompt: Thanks — we've noted the missing items. Please send photos of what you received (and the packing list if you have it). Our team will follow up to arrange the missing parts.
delivery_missing_parts_terminal.internal_note: Missing parts / incomplete delivery. Review order BOM vs customer description + photos. Ship missing parts or open carrier claim as needed.

delivery_wrong_item_terminal.prompt: Thanks — please send photos of the item you received (labels/serial if visible). Our team will confirm the order and arrange the correct product or a return label.
delivery_wrong_item_terminal.internal_note: Wrong item delivered. Compare Shopify/Netsuite order to photos. Arrange swap / return label / pickup.

delivery_never_arrived_terminal.prompt: Thanks — we've logged that the shipment never arrived (or was marked delivered but is missing). Our team will check carrier tracking and follow up with next steps.
delivery_never_arrived_terminal.internal_note: Never arrived / porch theft / false delivery scan. Check Track123/carrier POD, file claim or reship per policy.

delivery_late_terminal.prompt: Thanks — we've noted the late delivery. Our team will review the carrier timeline and follow up with an update or goodwill options if appropriate.
delivery_late_terminal.internal_note: Late delivery complaint. Verify ETA vs actual; carrier delay vs warehouse delay. Reply with status / courtesy credit if policy allows.

delivery_other_problem_q.prompt: Please briefly describe the delivery problem so our team can help.

delivery_other_problem_terminal.prompt: Thank you for the details. Our team will review your delivery situation and follow up shortly.
delivery_other_problem_terminal.internal_note: Other delivery problem (free-text). Read customer description + tracking snapshot; route to correct ops owner.

delivery_visible_damage_q.prompt: When the chair was delivered, was there any visible damage to the outer shipping box?

options.label: Yes, the box was visibly damaged

delivery_chair_inside_damage_q.prompt: Was the chair itself damaged when you opened the box (even though the outer box looked fine)?

options.label: Yes, the chair was damaged inside

delivery_signed_q.prompt: When you received the delivery, was the receipt signed as 'Cleared' (no damage noted) or 'Damaged' (damage was noted on the receipt)?

options.label: Signed as Cleared (no damage noted on receipt)

delivery_signed_cleared_terminal.prompt: Since the delivery was signed as clear, obtaining compensation can be difficult. However, please send us photos of the damage and our team will review your case.
delivery_signed_cleared_terminal.internal_note: Damage present but delivery was signed as cleared. Hard to get compensation. Admin to review photos and decide course of action.

delivery_damage_when_opened_q.prompt: Was the damage to the chair visible as soon as you opened the box?

options.label: Yes, it was visible immediately upon unboxing

delivery_replace_claim_terminal.prompt: Please send photos of both the damaged box and the damage to the chair. Our team will review and arrange either a repair or replacement at no cost to you.
delivery_replace_claim_terminal.internal_note: Signed as damaged + visible at unboxing. Admin action: send replacement part/chair and file carrier claim. Request signed delivery receipt and photos.

delivery_minor_comp_terminal.prompt: Please send us photos of the damage. If the damage is minor, our team may be able to offer a compensation.
delivery_minor_comp_terminal.internal_note: Damage noticed after delivery, signed as damaged. If minor: admin to offer small compensation. Admin to review photos and decide.

defect_problem_type.prompt: Which chair part or function is affected?

options.label: Power issue (chair won't turn on or has power problems)

defect_heating_which.prompt: Which heating issue best describes your situation?

options.label: Heating does not warm up at all
Heat turns on and off / works intermittently
Heat feels too hot or uneven

defect_heating_warmup_q.prompt: Massage chair heat is mild and takes time to build up. Have you run the heated program for at least 10 minutes and confirmed heat is turned ON from the remote?

options.label: Yes, ran for 10+ minutes with heat ON — still no warmth
No — I'll try a 10-minute warm-up first

defect_heating_not_heating_terminal.prompt: Let's confirm heat is enabled and give the chair time to warm up before deciding it needs service.
defect_heating_not_heating_terminal.internal_note: Heat reported not working. Confirm 10+ min warm-up, heat icon on remote ON, no thick covers blocking element. If still cold after DIY, advise the customer to contact warranty support for a heating-element review.

defect_heating_intermittent_terminal.prompt: Heat turning on and off can be normal cycling, but if heat fails completely after a while, our team can review the element.
defect_heating_intermittent_terminal.internal_note: Intermittent heat. DIY: time how long heat stays on, power cycle, retest. Recommend warranty support review if the pattern repeats.

defect_heating_too_hot_terminal.prompt: If heat feels too hot or uneven, stop using it and let the chair cool down before testing again. Our team can check the heating element if it persists.
defect_heating_too_hot_terminal.internal_note: Heat too hot / uneven. Safety first: stop use, cool 30 min, no thick blankets covering element. Escalate if repeats.

defect_voice_which.prompt: Which voice control issue best describes your situation?

options.label: Voice control does not respond to my commands
Voice picks up random commands / false triggers

defect_voice_not_working_terminal.prompt: Let's try a few voice control checks — many issues are fixed with the right commands and microphone placement.
defect_voice_not_working_terminal.internal_note: Voice not responding. Customer-safe DIY: supported commands, mic location, side panel connections. Team follow-up if still dead.

defect_voice_false_triggers_terminal.prompt: False voice triggers are often caused by background noise or TV audio. Here are settings and placement tips.
defect_voice_false_triggers_terminal.internal_note: Ghost/random voice pickup. Customer-safe: settings off, unplug when idle, reduce noise. Not a defect if sensitivity picks up ambient speech.

defect_air_location.prompt: Which part of the chair is not inflating properly?

defect_air_feet_worked_q.prompt: Has the air in the feet / calves area ever worked before?

options.label: Yes, it worked before but stopped

defect_air_feet_inflate_test.prompt: Please raise the footrest, then turn on the leg air from the remote. Now disconnect the air hose and check if air is blowing out. Is air coming out when you disconnect the hose?

options.label: Yes, air is blowing from the hose

defect_air_feet_hose_check.prompt: Please check all air hoses in the feet / calves area for any kinks or disconnected hoses. Are all hoses clear and properly connected?

options.label: Found a kinked or disconnected hose
All hoses look clear and connected

defect_air_hose_fix_terminal.prompt: Please clear any kinked hoses or reconnect any disconnected ones. This should restore the air inflation.
defect_air_hose_fix_terminal.internal_note: Hose was kinked or disconnected. DIY fix — no parts needed.

defect_air_tech_terminal.prompt: Thank you for checking! Our team will review your case and arrange the appropriate service.
defect_air_tech_terminal.internal_note: Air blowing from hose but not inflating. Hoses clear. Under warranty: tech needed — likely airbag leak or loose internal connection.

defect_air_pump_terminal.prompt: Our team will review your case and arrange the necessary service.
defect_air_pump_terminal.internal_note: Air never worked OR no air blowing from hose. Most likely air pump needs replacement.

defect_air_arms_worked_q.prompt: Has the air in the arm area ever worked before?

options.label: Yes, it worked before but stopped

defect_air_arms_hissing_q.prompt: Please remove the side panel and turn on the arm air massage. Disconnect the air hose from the base where it connects to the side panel. When the air is on, do you hear air blowing or a hissing sound?

options.label: Yes, I hear air blowing or hissing
No sound, no air at all

defect_air_arms_tech_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and arrange the necessary service.
defect_air_arms_tech_terminal.internal_note: Air blowing from base hose but not inflating arms. Under warranty: tech needed — airbag leak or loose connection in arms.

defect_air_shoulders_hissing_q.prompt: Please turn on the shoulder / hip air massage. Do you hear any air blowing or a hissing sound in the shoulder / hip area?

options.label: Yes, I hear air or hissing

defect_air_shoulders_tech_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and arrange the necessary service for the shoulder / hip airbag.
defect_air_shoulders_tech_terminal.internal_note: Hissing heard = airbag has a leak or loose connection in shoulders/hips. Under warranty: tech needed.

defect_air_footrest_raise.prompt: Please raise the footrest, turn on the leg air from the remote, and disconnect the air hose to check if air is blowing through it. Is air coming out when you disconnect the hose?

options.label: Yes, air is blowing from the hose

defect_air_footrest_white_glove_q.prompt: Was this chair installed or delivered by White Glove delivery service?

defect_air_footrest_wg_tech_terminal.prompt: Our team will send a technician to address this. It may be related to the installation.
defect_air_footrest_wg_tech_terminal.internal_note: White Glove installation + air blowing but footrest not inflating. Good chance air hose is sandwiched or blocked during install. Send tech to correct.

defect_air_footrest_hose_check_q.prompt: Please check if the air hose connected to the footrest area is clear — not kinked, sandwiched, or blocked. Is the hose clear?

options.label: Found a blocked or kinked hose

defect_air_side_panel_check.prompt: Please remove the side panel and turn on the air massage. Disconnect the air hose from the base where it connects to the side panel. Is air blowing from the base hose when you disconnect it?

options.label: Yes, air blows from the base hose

defect_air_side_white_glove_q.prompt: Was this chair installed or delivered by White Glove delivery service?

defect_air_side_wg_tech_terminal.prompt: Our team will send a technician to address the side panel air connection.
defect_air_side_wg_tech_terminal.internal_note: White Glove installation + air from base OK but not reaching side panel. Tech to correct hose connection.

defect_air_side_reconnect_terminal.prompt: Please try reconnecting the air hose from the base to the side panel fitting securely. This should restore the air in that area.
defect_air_side_reconnect_terminal.internal_note: Non-WG. Air from base hose OK. Side panel hose likely disconnected. DIY reconnect.

defect_air_base_check.prompt: When you turn on the air massage, do you hear the air pump running or a hissing sound from the base area?

options.label: Yes, I hear the pump or hissing

defect_air_base_white_glove_q.prompt: Was this chair installed or delivered by White Glove delivery service?

defect_air_base_wg_tech_terminal.prompt: Our team will send a technician to address the base air issue.
defect_air_base_wg_tech_terminal.internal_note: White Glove installation + pump running but base not inflating. Tech to correct.

defect_air_base_hose_terminal.prompt: Please check all base air hose connections for any kinks or loose fittings, and try reconnecting them securely.
defect_air_base_hose_terminal.internal_note: Non-WG. Pump running. Check/reconnect base hoses. DIY fix.

defect_cosmetic_location.prompt: Where is the cosmetic damage located on the chair?

defect_cosmetic_photo_terminal.prompt: Please send photos of the damage to service@osakititan.com. Our team will assess and determine the best resolution.
defect_cosmetic_photo_terminal.internal_note: Cosmetic damage on footrest or base. Request photos. Admin to decide repair vs. replace.

defect_cosmetic_side_check.prompt: First, please verify that the side panels are fully and correctly installed. Are the side panels properly in place?

options.label: Panels were not properly installed — now fixed
Panels are installed correctly but still damaged

defect_cosmetic_side_fixed_terminal.prompt: Please check if the issue is resolved now that the panels are properly installed.
defect_cosmetic_side_fixed_terminal.internal_note: Side panel was not installed correctly. Customer fixed it. Verify resolved — no further action needed unless issue persists.

defect_cosmetic_when_opened_q.prompt: Was the damage visible as soon as you opened the box?

options.label: Yes, it was visible when first unboxed
No, it was noticed later after use

defect_cosmetic_white_glove_q.prompt: Was this chair installed or delivered by White Glove delivery service?

defect_cosmetic_wg_terminal.prompt: Please send photos of the damage. Our team will review and arrange a resolution with the White Glove service provider at no cost to you.
defect_cosmetic_wg_terminal.internal_note: White Glove delivery + cosmetic damage visible at unboxing. File claim with WG company. Send replacement/repair. Request damage and box photos.

defect_cosmetic_delivery_signed_q.prompt: When you received your delivery, was the delivery receipt signed as 'Cleared' (no damage noted) or 'Damaged'?

defect_cosmetic_signed_cleared_terminal.prompt: Since the delivery was signed as clear, compensation can be difficult to secure. However, please send us photos and our team will review what we can do.
defect_cosmetic_signed_cleared_terminal.internal_note: Damage found but delivery signed as cleared. Hard to get compensation. Admin to review photos and decide.

defect_cosmetic_box_damage_q.prompt: Was there visible damage to the shipping box when the chair was delivered?

options.label: Yes, the box was visibly damaged

defect_cosmetic_box_photos_terminal.prompt: Please send photos of both the damaged box and the chair damage. Although the damage may not have been noted on the receipt, we will attempt to file a claim with the trucking company on your behalf.
defect_cosmetic_box_photos_terminal.internal_note: Signed damaged + visible box damage. Request box photos, chair photos, signed delivery receipt. Try to get compensated from trucking company.

defect_cosmetic_replace_terminal.prompt: Please send us photos of the damage. Our team will review and determine whether a repair or replacement is appropriate at no cost to you.
defect_cosmetic_replace_terminal.internal_note: Signed damaged + box appeared fine. Admin to send replacement part/chair and file claim.

defect_remote_power_q.prompt: Does the remote control have power? Is anything showing on the screen?

options.label: Yes, the remote has power / screen shows something
No, remote is completely unresponsive / blank screen

defect_remote_screen_q.prompt: Which best describes the remote issue?

options.label: All commands respond, but the screen is blank
The remote cable appears damaged or cut
Certain commands do not respond at all

defect_remote_blank_screen_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a replacement remote for you.
defect_remote_blank_screen_terminal.internal_note: Remote commands work but screen is blank. Send new remote.

defect_remote_cable_terminal.prompt: Our team will send a replacement cable and remote for you.
defect_remote_cable_terminal.internal_note: Remote cable is damaged or cut. Send new cable with remote.

defect_remote_partial_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and determine whether a remote or PCB replacement is needed.
defect_remote_partial_terminal.internal_note: Certain commands not responding. Replace remote or PCB — admin to diagnose which.

defect_remote_no_power_checks.prompt:
Let's troubleshoot step by step. Please check:
1. Is the fuse blown or broken?
2. Is the cable connection from the chair to the remote secure?
3. Does the remote work intermittently — sometimes on, sometimes off?

options.label: The fuse appears blown or broken
The cable connection seems loose or bad

defect_remote_fuse_terminal.prompt: Our team will send you a replacement fuse.
defect_remote_fuse_terminal.internal_note: Fuse is broken. Send replacement fuse.

defect_remote_connection_terminal.prompt: Please try unplugging the chair's cable connection and plugging it back in firmly. This often resolves remote connectivity issues.
defect_remote_connection_terminal.internal_note: Bad connection. Customer to unplug and replug chair cable. DIY fix.

defect_remote_intermittent_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a replacement remote for you.
defect_remote_intermittent_terminal.internal_note: Remote works intermittently. Send new remote.

defect_remote_pcb_check_terminal.prompt: Our team will further diagnose and arrange the appropriate solution.
defect_remote_pcb_check_terminal.internal_note: Fuse OK, connection OK, not intermittent. Likely remote or Power PCB issue. Admin to check if remote turns on from back switch and diagnose accordingly.

defect_rolling_problem_type.prompt: Which of the following best describes the problem with the massage mechanism?

options.label: Makes a loud noise when the mechanism moves up or down
Makes noise while giving the massage
Pops or clicks during the massage

defect_rolling_noise_updown_terminal.prompt: Our team will review this issue. We may need to inspect the mechanism and track.
defect_rolling_noise_updown_terminal.internal_note: Mech makes loud noise when moving up/down. Diagnostic steps: 1. Check strap not tangled with mech head. 2. Track may be damaged — need tech to inspect. 3. Check frame is not bent. 4. If track OK, mech needs replacement.

defect_rolling_noise_massage_terminal.prompt: Our team will review this noise issue with the massage mechanism.
defect_rolling_noise_massage_terminal.internal_note: Noise while massaging. Diagnostic: 1. Remove backpad — check for holes in backpad or backrest lining; replace if within warranty. 2. Verify strap not tangled with massage head.

defect_rolling_pops_terminal.prompt: Our team will review this popping / clicking issue.
defect_rolling_pops_terminal.internal_note: Pops when massaging. Diagnostic: 1. Check backpad is not bunched up — zip or velcro properly. 2. Check for holes in backrest lining or backpad.

defect_rolling_heads_q.prompt:
Please answer about the massage heads:
1. When you turn the chair OFF, do the massage heads move at all?
2. Have the massage heads ever worked properly?
3. Do the heads seem to have power but barely move?

options.label: Heads do not move at all (even when powering off)
Heads worked before but have now stopped
Heads seem to have power but barely move

defect_rolling_no_movement_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and arrange the necessary service for the massage mechanism.
defect_rolling_no_movement_terminal.internal_note: Massage heads do not move at all when powered off. Check fuse and powercord first; if both OK, likely Power PCB issue.

defect_rolling_worked_terminal.prompt: Our team will diagnose and arrange the appropriate repair.
defect_rolling_worked_terminal.internal_note: Heads worked before, now stopped. Check fuse and powercord; if OK, likely Power PCB. For older chairs: unplug power, unplug black & grey cables from back, replug, power on.

defect_rolling_power_no_move_terminal.prompt: Our team will assess and arrange the necessary repair for the massage mechanism.
defect_rolling_power_no_move_terminal.internal_note: Has power, slight motion, but won't move fully. Change mech or up/down motor. If Air 3D/4D model: broken air system may prevent mech from moving — check air too.

defect_power_remote_on_q.prompt: Does the chair's remote control turn ON when you press the power button?

options.label: No, remote does not turn on

defect_power_on_controls_q.prompt: With the remote on, what do you observe? (Select the best match)

options.label: Remote turns on but does not respond to any commands
The quick control panel works but the main remote does not
Turned on the back switch and heard something from the chair
One or more recline functions (backrest, ZG, footrest) not working

defect_power_remote_replace_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a replacement remote for you.
defect_power_remote_replace_terminal.internal_note: Remote on but doesn't respond to commands, OR quick control works but main remote doesn't. Replace remote.

defect_power_main_pcb_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and arrange the appropriate PCB repair or replacement.
defect_power_main_pcb_terminal.internal_note: Back power switch turned on + sound heard from chair = Main PCB issue. Replace Main PCB.

defect_power_recline_move_q.prompt: When you turn the chair OFF, does the non-functioning recline part (backrest, Zero Gravity, or footrest) move back to its default position on its own?

options.label: Yes, it moves back to its default position when powered off
No, it stays stuck in its current position

defect_power_actuator_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a replacement actuator for the non-functioning recline.
defect_power_actuator_terminal.internal_note: Other recline motors return to default on power-off. The non-working actuator needs replacement.

defect_power_main_pcb_wire_terminal.prompt: Our team will diagnose and arrange the necessary PCB or wiring repair.
defect_power_main_pcb_wire_terminal.internal_note: Non-functioning part stays stuck when powered off. Change Main PCB and verify wire connection to non-working actuator is properly connected.

defect_power_off_checks.prompt:
Let's troubleshoot step by step. Please check the following:
1. Is the powercord firmly plugged into both the chair and the wall outlet?
2. Does the wall outlet have power? (Test with another device)
3. Is the fuse on the chair intact?
4. Toggle the power switch on the back of the chair OFF then ON — do you hear a clicking sound?

options.label: Powercord connection appears to be the issue
The wall outlet has no power
The fuse appears blown or broken
Heard a clicking sound when toggling the back switch
No clicking sound and nothing resolved

defect_power_pcb_fuse_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and determine if a Power PCB or transformer fuse replacement is needed.
defect_power_pcb_fuse_terminal.internal_note: Powercord / outlet / fuse issue pointing to Power PCB or transformer fuse. Admin to confirm and arrange appropriate repair.

defect_power_clicking_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and determine if a remote replacement is needed.
defect_power_clicking_terminal.internal_note: Clicking sound when toggling back power switch = remote issue. Change remote.

defect_power_no_click_terminal.prompt: Our team will review and arrange a Power PCB replacement.
defect_power_no_click_terminal.internal_note: No clicking sound when toggling back power switch. Change Power PCB.

defect_recline_which.prompt: Which recline function is not working?

defect_recline_scope_q.prompt: Are any other recline functions (backrest, zero gravity, footrest) also not working?

options.label: One or more other recline functions are also not working
None of the recline functions work at all

defect_recline_move_q.prompt: When you turn the chair OFF, does the non-functioning recline part move back to its default position on its own?

options.label: Yes, it moves back to default when powered off

defect_recline_actuator_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a replacement actuator for the non-functioning recline.
defect_recline_actuator_terminal.internal_note: Other recline motors return to default on power-off. Replace the non-working actuator.

defect_recline_main_pcb_wire_terminal.prompt: Our team will diagnose and arrange the necessary PCB or wiring repair.
defect_recline_main_pcb_wire_terminal.internal_note: Non-functioning recline part stays stuck. Change Main PCB and verify wire to non-working actuator is properly connected.

defect_recline_main_pcb_terminal.prompt: Our team will arrange a Main PCB replacement.
defect_recline_main_pcb_terminal.internal_note: None of the recline functions work at all. Replace Main PCB.

defect_footrest_which.prompt: What specifically is the issue with the footrest / legrest?

options.label: Airbags are NOT inflating in the footrest

defect_footrest_extend_terminal.prompt: Our team will review the leg extension issue and arrange the appropriate repair or replacement.
defect_footrest_extend_terminal.internal_note: Legrest does not extend. Admin to inspect extension actuator/mechanism and arrange repair or replacement.

defect_footrest_foot_rollers_terminal.prompt: Our team will review the foot roller issue and arrange the appropriate service.
defect_footrest_foot_rollers_terminal.internal_note: Foot rollers not working. Admin to diagnose roller motor/mechanism and send replacement parts or schedule service.

defect_footrest_calf_roller_terminal.prompt: Our team will review the calf roller issue and arrange the appropriate service.
defect_footrest_calf_roller_terminal.internal_note: Calf roller not working. Admin to diagnose calf roller motor/mechanism and send replacement parts or schedule service.
